items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. It was addressed in APSB26-92.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released security updates resolving critical and important vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover, arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges. It was addressed in APSB26-92.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges. It was addressed in APSB26-92.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (B2B)
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability affects Adobe Commerce B2B and could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges. It was addressed in APSB26-92.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges. It was addressed in APSB26-92.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Amasty patches dozens of Magento extensions, 2 critical
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for dozens of extensions, including two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store using a polyglot to bypass validation. Adobe released Magento 2.4.9 with the fix, but it was not backported to older versions.
